verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the core loop. Claude accepts data files such as CSV, XLSX and JSON (claude-docs-14). It can 'generate code and visualize data' (claude-docs-41) and 'produce reports with charts and visualizations' (claude-docs-55). It also generates Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files you can download immediately (claude-docs-15), and artifacts provide visualizations (claude-docs-28). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Claude actually executes code in a sandbox to compute answers (the evidence only implies it), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the data-analysis workflow.
